minigames.name: Spin Cycle
minigames.caption: Jump and duck as the ramp speeds up.
minigames.description: Jump the orange rods and duck under the violet ones as the spiral ramp speeds up. Seven hits and you’re out. Last robot standing wins. Playing alone? Survive for 90 seconds.
minigames.controls: `Space` or `Up` to jump over orange rods. Hold `S` or `Down` to duck under violet rods.
minigames.touchControls: tap the right side to jump and hold the left side to duck.

screenshot.alt: Colorful robots jump a sweeping bar on a circular arena.

minigames.name: Live Wire
minigames.caption: Paint the floor and dodge the surges.
minigames.description: Race to paint a hex floor in your color. Close a loop to lock in your tiles, dodge the reactor’s surges, and dash into rivals to knock them off course. Most tiles after 90 seconds wins.
minigames.controls: `W``A``S``D` or the arrow keys to run. Press `Space` to dash and shove.
minigames.touchControls: drag your left thumb to move and tap the right side to dash.

screenshot.alt: Six robots on a hex floor painted in their colors while red surge lines cross the board.

minigames.name: Bumper Cars
minigames.caption: Stay afloat as the dock shrinks.
minigames.description: Boost into rivals on a floating dock with no railings. Five rings sink one at a time, shrinking the arena. Stay out of the water and be the last car afloat.
minigames.controls: `W``A``S``D` or the arrow keys to steer. Press `Space` to boost. Follow the inward chevrons when the next ring is about to sink.
minigames.touchControls: drag your left thumb to steer and tap the right side to boost.

screenshot.alt: Bumper cars on a floating dock with inward chevrons marking the sinking ring and a Move In warning.

minigames.name: Sumo
minigames.caption: Shove rivals out of the ring to score.
minigames.description: Shove rivals out of a fixed ring to score. If you fall, you respawn quickly and can get back in the fight. The highest score after 90 seconds wins.
minigames.controls: `W``A``S``D` or the arrow keys to move. Let go to brace. Press `Space` to shove.
minigames.touchControls: drag your left thumb to move, let go to brace, and tap the right side to shove.

screenshot.alt: Robots competing inside the Sumo ring and a scoreboard tracking knockouts.

minigames.name: Orb Racing
minigames.caption: Clear the checkpoints and finish three laps.
minigames.description: Race for three laps and drive through the checkpoints in order. Cross the recharge strips to refill your boost.
minigames.controls: `W``A``S``D` or the arrow keys to steer. Press `Space` to boost.
minigames.touchControls: drag your left thumb to steer and tap the right side to boost.

screenshot.alt: Racers on the Orb Racing track with lap and position indicators.

minigames.name: Stampede Sheriff
minigames.caption: Herd critters and steal them from your rivals.
minigames.description: Walk behind wind-up critters to guide them into your pen. Clap to scatter a herd or steal it from a rival. Watch the hatches for double-value critters. Most points after 90 seconds wins.
minigames.controls: `W``A``S``D` or the arrow keys to move. Press `Space` to clap in the last direction you moved.
minigames.touchControls: drag your left thumb to move and tap the right side to clap.

screenshot.alt: Robots herd wind-up critters toward colored pens as a gold critter emerges from a hatch.

minigames.name: Plate Panic
minigames.caption: Tilt the table and redirect rolling marbles.
minigames.description: Every robot’s weight tilts the same tabletop. Roll marbles into your pocket or drop a wedge to redirect a roll. The player who pockets the most marbles in 90 seconds wins.
minigames.controls: `W``A``S``D` or the arrow keys to move and tilt the table. Press `Space` to place a wedge in the last direction you moved.
minigames.touchControls: drag your left thumb to move and tap the right side to place a wedge.

screenshot.alt: Robots tilt a tabletop with rolling marbles, wedges, and six colored scoring pockets.

minigames.name: Salvage Line
minigames.caption: Tow cargo home and cut rival lines.
minigames.description: Hook floating crates and tow them into your numbered harbor to deliver them. Heavy crates slow your tug but score double. Cut a rival’s exposed tow rope to send their cargo adrift. The most cargo weight delivered in 90 seconds wins.
minigames.controls: `W``A``S``D` or the arrow keys to steer. Press `Space` to hook, cut, or release. Tap it inside your harbor to deliver your cargo.
minigames.touchControls: drag your left thumb to steer and tap the right side to use the winch.

screenshot.alt: Numbered tugboats tow floating crates across the harbor with their tow lines visible.

minigames.name: Popcorn Catch
minigames.caption: Catch popcorn and bank your bowl before it spills.
minigames.description: Chase the landing marks to catch falling popcorn. Bank at any rim shelf and earn a bonus for bringing at least four kernels. A wobbling bowl spills half its load on the next catch. Most points banked in 90 seconds wins.
minigames.controls: `W``A``S``D` or the arrow keys to steer. On a controller, use the left stick or D-pad. Catch popcorn and bank automatically.
minigames.touchControls: drag on either half of the screen to steer the bowl.

screenshot.alt: Six numbered bowls chase falling popcorn and glowing landing marks inside a brass-rimmed cabinet.

minigames.name: Knockdown Carnival
minigames.caption: Bank foam pucks to topple a chain of targets.
minigames.description: Choose a shot line and flick a puck at your targets or bank it into the shared relay shelf. Follow its arrows to topple two or three targets in one shot. Most targets knocked down in 90 seconds wins.
minigames.controls: `A` and `D` or `Left` and `Right` to aim. Press `Space` or `Up` to flick. On a controller, use the left stick or D-pad to aim and A to flick.
minigames.touchControls: drag your left thumb left or right to aim, then tap the right half to flick.

screenshot.alt: Six colorful foam-puck launchers face hinged targets and a shared relay shelf in a plum carnival cabinet.

minigames.name: Sky Stack
minigames.caption: Draft toy blocks and build the tallest tower.
minigames.description: Request a block from the shared carousel, then choose a supported stud to place it. Compete for tall molds or use a wide foundation to open more landing spots later. The tallest tower after six waves wins.
minigames.controls: `A` and `D` or `Left` and `Right` to choose a block or stud. Press `Space` to confirm. On a controller, use the left stick or D-pad and press A to confirm.
minigames.touchControls: drag your left thumb left or right to select, then tap the right half to confirm.

screenshot.alt: Six colorful toy towers in workshop bays, with outline previews showing where the next blocks fit.

minigames.name: Domino Dash
minigames.caption: Race rivals to the bridge and topple the chain.
minigames.description: Topple your numbered starter, then race to a shared bridge. Tap when the diamond lines up to claim the row before rivals. Each fallen domino scores a point. The most points after six waves wins.
minigames.controls: `W``A``S``D` or the arrow keys to move. Press `Space` to topple. On a controller, use the left stick or D-pad and press A to topple.
minigames.touchControls: drag your left thumb to move, then tap the right half to topple when you’re in range.

screenshot.alt: Six numbered players race between colorful domino rows and diamond bridge markers on a wooden workbench.

minigames.name: Freezer Door
minigames.caption: Open a drawer and time your release for double points.
minigames.description: Hold a freezer drawer open to warm a treat, then release when the solid needle reaches the striped band for two points. Every open drawer also heats its neighbors. Take up to two treats before each restock. Most points after eight restocks wins.
minigames.controls: `W``A``S``D` or the arrow keys to select a drawer. Hold `Space` to open it and release to collect. On a controller, use the left stick or D-pad to select and hold A to open.
minigames.touchControls: drag your left thumb to select a drawer. Hold your right thumb down to open it, then lift to collect.

screenshot.alt: Six numbered players open drawers in a frosted cabinet. Striped temperature bands and arrows between drawers show which treats are warming.

minigames.name: Bandwagon
minigames.caption: Tug a toy parade toward your crest’s arch.
minigames.description: Latch onto the parade and tug left or right to vote for an arch. The tie arrow decides even votes. Ride through to score one point and earn another if your crest matches. Visit a booth to switch crests before the turnout locks. Highest score after six crossings wins.
minigames.controls: `W``A``S``D` or the arrow keys to steer. Hold `Space` at your numbered hitch to latch, then press left or right to tug. On a controller, steer with the left stick or D-pad and hold A to latch.
minigames.touchControls: drag your left thumb to steer and tug. Hold your right thumb down to latch at your numbered hitch.

screenshot.alt: Numbered toy floats pull the parade engine toward star and diamond arches. The tug tally shows which arch is ahead.

minigames.name: Hat Clause
minigames.caption: Swap hats and match your ticket before the bell.
minigames.description: Walk up to a player with a different hat and tap to offer a swap. If they tap back, you trade. Your first swap each bell earns one point, and wearing the hat on your ticket earns two more. Make a deal or get fitted at the reserve counter before time runs out.
minigames.controls: `W``A``S``D` or the arrow keys to move. Press `Space` to offer, cancel, or start a fitting at your counter spot. On a controller, move with the left stick or D-pad and press A to act.
minigames.touchControls: drag your left thumb to move, then tap the right half to offer a trade or get fitted.

screenshot.alt: Numbered players wear different hats and signal trades in front of the reserve hatcheck counter.

minigames.name: Gap Band
minigames.caption: Claim a drum slot and outguess the other players.
minigames.description: Choose a slot, then keep your note or move it once before playback. A solo note earns one point, or two on the accent. Shared slots play a rest and earn zero. Listen or watch the drum machine play all nine measures.
minigames.controls: `A` and `D` or the arrow keys to select a slot. Press `Space` to confirm. On a controller, choose with the stick or D-pad and press A to confirm.
minigames.touchControls: tap a drum slot to select it, then tap Confirm.

screenshot.alt: A drum machine plays numbered player notes across seven slots, including a striped muted collision and a highlighted accent.

minigames.name: Wobble Workshop
minigames.caption: Latch the toy’s joints and keep it upright.
minigames.description: Wind a joint and release in the striped band to latch it for a point. Then pick one shared joint. Every latch changes the toy’s balance, and the ghost needle previews your effect. If the toy stands at the bell, everyone who latched a joint earns a bonus.
minigames.controls: `A` and `D` or `Left` and `Right` to select a joint. Hold `Space` to wind and release to latch. On a controller, choose with the stick or D-pad and hold A to wind.
minigames.touchControls: tap a joint to choose it. Hold Sweep, then lift your thumb in the striped band to latch.

screenshot.alt: A spring-mounted toy automaton leans on a workshop bench, with numbered joints and a shared balance gauge.

extraScreenshots.alt: The Gizmo Jam menu with the local lineup showing a color selector, optional bots, and open seats.
extraScreenshots.caption: Pick a color and play with one to six participants. Add bots to any open seats you want to fill.

extraScreenshots.alt: A late Spin Cycle round with some robots knocked out and the ramp at high speed.
extraScreenshots.caption: Spin Cycle speeds up as the round goes on
